concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-point-of-sale-basic-tapi-integration-verify-transaction-status]] — Adyen Docs website guide to TransactionStatusRequest recovery of missing terminal/mobile transaction responses and original-result interpretation (2026-09-15 snapshot).
warnings: Status-response Success means the original transaction reached an end state, not necessarily an approved payment; read the repeated original response.
NotFound can also reflect wrong original identifiers; do not retry solely from that status.
